liveness_readiness_routes.description: Publish Console's GET /health/live and /health/ready routes. Disable when the App owns liveness and readiness; /health/startup remains available.

agent_home.description: Private state root for the restricted Console Agent.

agent_configuration_store.description: Host-owned SQLite authority for durable Console Agent configuration proposals, publication history, and desired-state recovery.

allowed_tools.description: Reviewed model-visible Tools admitted to the Console Agent.

connected_agent_label.description: Identity label for the optional App Agent contributed to this Console.

console_agent_url.description: Optional clean loopback HTTP origin of a Console Agent. Empty disables Agent integration; an App Console requires no Agent.

agent_control_token_file.description: Optional Host-private file containing the shared Agent bearer token. The token itself never enters the Resolved App Plan.

connected_agent_auth_connections.description: Explicitly authorizes Console to manage App Agent authentication connections.

connected_agent_plugin_configuration.description: Explicitly authorizes Console to consume the App Agent Host's Plugin configuration capability.

connected_agent_plugin_lifecycle.description: Explicitly authorizes Console to consume the App Agent Host's trusted Plugin package lifecycle capability.

connected_agent_url.description: Clean loopback HTTP origin used by the optional App Agent Adapter.

managed_app_root.description: Lenso App whose ordinary Plugin Root is managed by Console.

trusted_plugin_bundles.description: Host-private trusted Bundle catalog keyed by opaque entry ID. Paths resolve from the launcher directory and are never exposed to Console Agent.

web_root.description: Directory containing the built Console Shell index.html.

managed_apps.description: Explicit Plugin management connections for non-Agent Apps and the Console extension authority. These targets do not become conversational Agents.

local_projects.description: Optional local project launcher paths owned by the reference Console Host.

require_user_session.description: Require the explicitly bound Lenso Auth provider for Console API requests. Local mode has no Auth binding and remains loopback-only.

administrator_subjects.description: Auth subjects allowed to administer Console and access shared Host Agent interfaces. Workspace Plugins enforce their own business authorization.

member_workspace_ids.description: Workspace IDs exposed to authenticated members. These Plugins must enforce their own business authorization.

max_assertion_ttl_seconds.description: Maximum trusted short-lived actor assertion lifetime. Auth issuance must use the same limit or a shorter one.

human_interface.description: Explicitly enables the separately bound human review capability. Never exposed as Agent or MCP tools.

operators_profile.description: Explicit operators realm trust and deployment scope. Requires Auth and Access Control; legacy shared Agent/App proxies remain unavailable.

assistant_access.description: Independent assistant access. Omitted preserves local/single administrator compatibility. Explicit policy defaults to deny; does not grant Console administration.
